mapper.select: select ID, MACHINE_CODE, MACHINE_NAME, QUATA, CLASS_SHIFT, OPEN_MACHINE_CLASS, STATUS, REMARK from T_GSQ_MACHINE_INFO where STATUS = '0' and DEL_FLAG = '0'

select STEEL_RING_CODE, GROUP_CONCAT(sm.MACHINE_ID ORDER BY sm.MACHINE_ID SEPARATOR ',') as machine_ids from T_GSQ_SPECIFY_MACHINE sm inner join T_GSQ_MACHINE_INFO m on sm.machine_id = m.id where sm.DEL_FLAG = '0'
and sm.JOB_TYPE = #{jobType} /*限制作业 类型*/
and m.STATUS = '0' and m.DEL_FLAG = '0' group by STEEL_RING_CODE
select null as SPEC, null as ORDER_WAY, null as machine_ids from dual where 1 = 0

SELECT BEAD_CODE steelRingCode, max(concat(DIMENSION , '~' ,BEAD_ARRANGE)) specOrder FROM T_PRODUCT_CONSTRUCTION_INFO where (embryo_code,EMBRYO_VERSION) in (SELECT embryo_code,BOM_DATA_VERSION FROM T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT where schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') ) group by BEAD_CODE

SELECT STEEL_RING_CODE, max(MACHINE_ID) machine_ids FROM T_GSQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = DATE_ADD(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL -1 DAY) AND DEL_FLAG = '0' AND NIGHT_PLAN_QTY > 0 GROUP BY STEEL_RING_CODE
